description: This file defines the PdfAcroForm class, which models an interactive PDF form (AcroForm) within the PDFsharp library. It provides mechanisms to access form fields, manage dictionaries related to AcroForm properties, and includes nested classes for dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfAcroForm
classes.description: Represents an interactive PDF form (AcroForm), providing access to form fields and form properties.

classes.name: PdfAcroForm.Keys
classes.description: Defines the dictionary keys for PdfAcroForm properties, such as Fields, NeedAppearances, etc.

methods.name: PdfAcroForm.PdfAcroForm(PdfDocument)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an AcroForm with a document context.

methods.name: PdfAcroForm.PdfAcroForm(PdfDictionary)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an AcroForm from an existing dictionary.

methods.name: PdfAcroForm.get_Fields
methods.description: Accessor property that retrieves the collection of form fields, initializing it if necessary.
